attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Last seen near the southern edge of Lowmere","reason":"The briefing gives no last-seen location for Quell."},{"span":"has not returned to any known Outlander settlement","reason":"This adds detail about Quell's whereabouts that the briefing does not give."},{"span":"disrupting trade between Lowmere and the Brine Coast League","reason":"The briefing does not link the ferry to trade or to either party."},{"span":"No casualties were reported","reason":"The briefing says nothing about casualties."},{"span":"the damage is expected to delay supplies for weeks","reason":"This consequence and its timeframe are invented."},{"span":"citing “unforeseen risks.”","reason":"This is an invented quote and reason."}],"voice":2,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":1,"comment":"The bulletin copies the briefing's section header verbatim, which breaks character. It also pads every item with invented details, including a last-seen location, trade disruption, a casualty report and a fabricated quote. The writing is plain wire-service copy with none of Ilse's dry, wry voice, though each item is easy to follow."}
